doc: Per-family beacon text (H6). render_shims.py renders each variant into 00-bootstrap/dist/ for the outputs in surfaces.json whose render is 'beacon'; render_shims.py --check fails on drift and on a variant over its max_bytes. Families must be keys of surfaces.json families. Installing is a human step (installers.py); the Codex beacon counts toward the 32 KiB Codex window, so its max_bytes keeps the 3 KiB headroom gate.

identity: WORKSPACE = the single source of truth for my rules, skills, knowledge, and session state.
- Local root: ~/Projects/workspace · Remote: github.com/snds/workspace (GitHub if no local disk).
protocol: LOAD PROTOCOL for interactive sessions — before any task, tool, or task-skill:
1. Read AGENTS.md at the workspace root (on chat: the Workspace project knowledge, or GitHub via a connector) and follow its read order.
2. Open your first reply with exactly ONE ritual line:
[workspace: LOADED · <branch>@<sha> · <date> · via:<layer>]  — you read live workspace content
[workspace: RULES-ONLY · via:<surface>]  — this surface cannot fetch files; the rules still govern
[workspace: UNREACHABLE · <reason>]  — you should have read it but could not
EXEMPTION: when the caller demands raw structured output (headless -p, subagent data, API script), skip the ritual line; the rules still apply.
standing: STANDING RULES (in force even before loading):
rules: - Figma work uses real library components, never hand-built shapes.
- Durable context/learnings/decisions are written to the workspace, never to local agent memory.
- Employer repos never receive personal-workspace content, and workspace content is never pasted into employer surfaces.
ws: - Neutral: `ws status` · `ws resolve repo <path>` · work request: `ws route --stdin <<'EOF'`…`EOF`, load its output.
cursor_head: WORKSPACE (github.com/snds/workspace, local ~/Projects/workspace) holds my rules, skills and session state; its AGENTS.md is the contract. Read it before working there.
projects_head: Repos live here; the contract is ./workspace/AGENTS.md.
Before working in a repo, run `ws resolve repo <path>`; its profile sets the rules.
